note: Missouri River access shared with Chamois City Park, with a boat ramp. The campsites are city-run: a gravel row with tables and hookup posts on a mowed bank west of the ramp lane, facing a side channel of the river behind a rock training dike. Contact the city for rates and to arrange a stay. Spot length is not published. --Claude
summary: MDC page: 4 individual campsites WITH electric and water, run by the city of Chamois (contact the city). So the stored MDC defaults (electric 0, water false, $0, FCFS) were wrong: water true written, electric/sewer/fees/reservable/fcfs cleared to unknown, count 4 written. Riverview kept: the site row is ~32-40 m from the river's side channel across open mowed grass with a thin bank tree line (camper reports '5 sites facing the Missouri River'). Pin ~35 m E on the paved lot (fine; move optional). Phones to review.
flags: FEES/OPERATOR: the area page says the 4 campsites have electric and water and to 'Contact the city of Chamois ... (573) 536-2997'. These are city-run hookup sites, so the stored MDC free/no-hookup values were removed. A camper review on Campendium (undated) reports $15/night, paid to a city worker who comes by with a form, with 20/30/50-amp and water, a dump station and showers at the city park. It's undated and not an operator source, so not written. Under the camper-report rule a dated 2024+ report could price it if AWH wants. The city has no web page found.

PHONE: stored 573-815-7900 = MDC regional office (on the page). The page gives the city of Chamois (573) 536-2997 for the campsites; a camper review gives 573-763-5541 for reservations. Suggest the city number from the MDC page, 573-536-2997.

WATERFRONT (stored riverview, kept). Measured on the 0.12 m/px leaf-off frame: the gravel site row with tables (~38.6808,-91.7737) sits 32-40 m from the water's edge, across an open mowed apron to a thin band of bank shrubs and a few tall trees. There's no road between; the ramp lane is east of the sites. The water directly in front is a side channel of the Missouri behind a rock training dike, and the main channel is ~60 m out. Two camper reviews describe the sites as 'facing the Missouri River' and 'along the Missouri River'. Not riverfront: the bank brush strip and the ~35 m apron.
PIN: stored 38.68096,-91.77320 = GIS camping point 333, on the paved ramp lot ~35 m east of the site row. Acceptable (lot beside the sites); optional move to 38.6808,-91.7737.
INCLUSION/FIT: 'Individual Campsites' with hookups on level gravel (camper report); a 23-ft rig fits per the reviews (no length published).
